objectives.description: Source-store-first resolution for update-task-status.sh and deploy-freshness-lib.sh

approaches_tried.approach: Fixture with no plan file for cases 2-5
approaches_tried.reason: update-plan-status.sh exits 1 when no plan directory exists, which update_plan_file() treats as FATAL (exit 3) on postflight/implement -- unrelated to the deploy-check gate itself but blocks reaching the assertions. Fixed by adding a minimal conforming plan file to build_fixture_repo(), matching test-update-task-status.sh's own fixture pattern.

deviations.description: bash .../run-all.sh lists the new suite and its overall exit code is no worse than a pre-change baseline run
deviations.reason: Full run-all.sh run launched in background (gate 8 alone costs ~118s); auto-discovery confirmed directly via the same glob pattern (test-*.sh) run-all.sh itself uses, rather than waiting synchronously for the full run before proceeding to Phase 5/6. The background run's result is checked and recorded before Phase 8's final verification.
